does: Decides whether the turn order must pause for a combatant under crowd control: checks that the entity is alive and reads its combat state and statuses through the turn-order world view.

evidence.says: takes the turn-order system's world view (combat participant, IsInCombat, Incapacitated, LoseControl, StatusImmunities and others) and the status prototype manager, checks ecs::EntityWorld::IsEntityAlive and the combat StateComponent
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on (10 of the 14 fight segments), from 1 place

questions.ask: which statuses make it return true; a fight with a sleeping or held creature at its turn would show it
